---
name: Bug or documentation correction
about: Report a broken asset, index, script, demo or misleading documentation
title: "[Bug] "
---

## Affected asset / 涉及素材

Stable ID, repository path or public demo route, and commit/version if known.

## What happened / 问题

Expected behavior, actual behavior and minimal reproduction steps.

## Environment / 环境

Browser, viewport, operating system or Node version when relevant. Share a redacted minimal example; do not paste private links, customer data, credentials or raw production logs.

## Evidence / 证据

Optional screenshot or test result that you have permission to share. Distinguish actual runtime behavior from an illustrative graphic.
